metadata.technology: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor Probe (with MCU + radio)
metadata.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe with integrated microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless communication module
metadata.technology_reasoning: Capacitive soil moisture sensors with integrated MCUs and radio modules are industry-standard for precise, low-power, and wireless soil moisture monitoring used widely in agriculture and environmental sensing, offering reliable measurements and direct data transmission capabilities.

components.reasoning: Core sensing component that measures soil permittivity changes to determine moisture content; always present and procured or manufactured as a distinct sensor probe.
Essential embedded controller for signal processing, data acquisition, and system control; typically integrated on a separate PCB or module.

components.component: Wireless Communication Module (e.g., sub-GHz radio or LoRa)
components.reasoning: Provides radio interface for remote data transmission; often a distinct module or chip separate from the MCU with its own antenna.
Physical platform housing and interconnecting electronic components including MCU, radio, and sensor interface; distinct assembly typically procured or fabricated separately.
Primary power source for standalone operation, commonly a replaceable or rechargeable battery or integrated energy harvesting unit.
Structural component that protects the sensor and electronics from environmental damage and enables soil immersion; typically a molded plastic or sealed enclosure.
Critical for wireless communication range and reliability; often a separate component or substrate antenna integrated on PCB.
